title: What Is Playably? Gamified Rebates for Shopify Brands, Not Playable Ads
summary: Learn what Playably is: the playably.ai company running gamified conditional rebates for Shopify brands, separate from Playable and playable ads.
body_markdown:
## Introduction


Playably, at[playably.ai](https://playably.ai/) , runs gamified conditional rebates for Shopify brands. Playably is a different company from Playable, and Playably is not the playable-ad format.


Shoppers pay full price, and if a real-world trigger hits, Playably pays them 100% of their order back, with the payout insured and hedged so the brand pays $0 of the rebate.


The names are close, so the mix-up is easy. One letter separates them in a search bar.


This page settles it. It covers what Playably does, how the Play & Win loop works, where playable ads fit inside a Playably campaign, and what Playably sells.


If you searched "Playably vs Playable", the short answer is above. Playably and Playable are two different companies.


### Key Takeaways


- Playably runs gamified conditional rebates for Shopify brands at[playably.ai](http://playably.ai/) .
- Playably is a different company from Playable.
- Playably is not the playable-ad format; playable ads are one channel.
- Playably insures and hedges the payout, so brands pay $0 of the rebate.
- Shoppers pay full price and can win 100% of their order back.


## What Playably does


Playably is a gamified rebate platform for Shopify brands. Instead of running a discount, a brand ties an offer to a real-world moment its shoppers already follow, such as a sports final, a weather event or a cultural moment.


Shoppers buy at full price and are automatically entered, with no code to remember. If the trigger hits, Playably pays them 100% of their order back by Venmo or PayPal.


Playably insures and hedges the payout, handles the legal work, designs the assets and builds the playbook. So the brand pays $0 of the rebate and keeps its full margin.


The same Play & Win loop runs on the store, in playable ads, in store by QR and at live events. Every play returns zero party data the brand can use long after the campaign ends.


Most Playably campaigns go live in days rather than months. Playably says it has launched 30 or more Shopify brands with 100% retention.


The category has its own name. See[what a gamified rebate is](https://playably.ai/pages/gamified-rebates) for the full definition.


## Playably, Playable and playable ads are three different things


Three similar words point to three different things. Getting them straight saves you a wasted demo call.


**Playably** is the company at[playably.ai](http://playably.ai/) . It runs gamified conditional rebates for Shopify brands.


**Playable** is a different company.


**A playable ad** is an ad format, not a company. A Playably campaign can run inside one, alongside on-site, in-store and live event entry points.


The spelling matters too. Playably also publishes a self-serve Shopify app, listed as the[PlayAbly app](https://apps.shopify.com/playably) on the Shopify App Store, with a capital A.

## How the Play & Win loop works


Playably calls its core mechanic the Play & Win loop. Shoppers see it in four steps.


**1. See the offer.** A sponsored unit on the store ties the offer to a real moment.


**2. Enter with an email.** One step tells Playably where to send the win.


**3. Buy at full price.** Shoppers check out as usual and get auto-entered, with no code to remember.


**4. Get the win email.** If the trigger hits, a quick form and they're paid by Venmo or PayPal, usually within days.


On the brand side, the job is shorter still. Your team approves the brief; we run every one.


Playably wires the campaign, widget and payout. No dev work, no discounting on your end.


Read[how a gamified rebate works](https://playably.ai/pages/rebates) for the trigger, the full price checkout and the 100% back, step by step.


## Where playable ads fit inside a Playably campaign


A playable ad is one surface the Play & Win loop can run on. It is not the product.


Online, a Playably campaign runs as "a playable ad, a link in bio, or an on-site widget at checkout, live the same day." In store, "a QR on the packaging or a POS sign turns any shelf into an entry point."


At live events, the entry point is "a code on the jumbotron, a text after kickoff, a card at the gate."


Brick & mortar, ecom and events all run on one loop.


So a brand that only wants a playable ad is shopping for a format. A brand that wants shoppers to pay full price and win their order back when a real moment hits is shopping for Playably.


Playably also builds games outright. The[bespoke shoppable game build](https://playably.ai/products/build-fee-bespoke-shoppable-game-build) is estimated at $10K to $25K, based on the complexity of the game concept, custom illustrations and development requirements.


On that build, you own the game and the data it generates. Playably can update it afterwards for a nominal fee.


## What Playably sells


Playably sells one flagship service, two productised builds and a self-serve app. Each one is separate, so pick the one that matches the job.


**The gamified conditional rebate campaign.** The flagship, tied to a real-world trigger, with the payout insured and hedged. Pricing is performance based, so you only pay when a sale happens.


**The Tier 1 build fee and revenue share program.** A one-time build fee of about $1,500 for a gamified email and landing page test with a quiz and a dedicated brand strategist. A 15% revenue share applies on transactions from shoppers who play the game or give their email during play.


**The bespoke shoppable game build.** Estimated at $10K to $25K, as above, with the brand owning the game.


**The PlayAbly Shopify app.** The PlayAbly app is listed on the Shopify App Store as free, with swipe-to-shop and product matchup formats, email capture and a real time dashboard.


The[Tier 1 build fee page](https://playably.ai/products/tier-1-build-fee) has the full scope of that program.


## Proof that identifies Playably


Brands that have run Playably campaigns are named on the site. BlackBoxMyCar saw 18.25× ROAS on rebate ads during March Madness 2026.


Buckle Me Baby Coats saw sales jump 23% on launch and participant AOV rise 40%. Michu Pet saw 3× email conversion rate, and Jones New York saw 5× revenue per send.


Playably was featured in Inc. for its risk hedged rebate model. Read[Playably's Inc. feature post](https://playably.ai/blogs/about-gamification/playably-featured-inc) on the blog.


The site header carries one award line, "Winner ShopTalk Startup of the Year." More brand results sit on[Playably's case studies page](https://playably.ai/pages/case-studies) .


## Conclusion


Playably is the company at[playably.ai](http://playably.ai/) that runs gamified conditional rebates for Shopify brands. Playable is a different company, and a playable ad is a format Playably can run in, never the product itself.


Playably insures and hedges the payout, so shoppers pay full price, winners get 100% of their order back, and you pay $0 of the rebate. Ready to replace discounts with delight?
